exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Which Style Do You Like
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Which period of Western art do you like most, Ben?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I'm really fond of Impressionism, especially Monet's garden scenes.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Why Impressionism? Isn't it a bit blurry?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: That's the beauty of it. The painters caught light and feeling, not every detail.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I see. I prefer modern art myself, like Picasso.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Picasso? His shapes always confuse me a little.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Maybe, but he makes me ask a question: what is art, really?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: That's a great reason. Perhaps we should visit the museum together this weekend.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 问 Ben 最喜欢西方艺术哪个时期;Ben 喜欢印象派,尤其莫奈的花园;因为画家捕捉的是光与感觉而非细节;Anna 更喜欢以毕加索为代表的现代艺术;因为它让她思考'艺术是什么';两人约周末一起去博物馆。

options: The painters caught light and feeling.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Ink Wash Animation
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Today I'd like to talk about Chinese ink wash animation films.
These films grew out of the old art of ink wash painting.
The most famous one was produced in the 1960s and is still loved today.
Because each frame is hand-painted, the gentle pictures seem to move and breathe.
Sadly, this beautiful style later went into decline because it took so much time and money.
exercises.translation_cn: 演讲者介绍中国水墨动画片;它源于古老的水墨画;最著名的一部产生于20世纪60年代,至今仍受喜爱;因为每一帧都是手绘,柔和的画面仿佛会动会呼吸;遗憾的是,这种美丽的风格因耗时耗钱而后来衰落了。

questions.stem: What did ink wash animation films grow out of?
options: The old art of ink wash painting.

questions.stem: When was the most famous film produced?
Why do the pictures seem to move and breathe?
Why did this style later go into decline?
options: It took too much time and money.
It was banned by the museum.

questions.stem: How does the speaker feel about this kind of film?
options: The speaker thinks it is ugly.
The speaker admires it as a beautiful art.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Monet's Garden
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: This room shows Monet's famous garden at Giverny.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: It's beautiful. Did he really paint the same garden so many times?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Yes. He was especially fond of the water lilies on his pond.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Why did he keep returning to the same scene?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: He wanted to show how the light changed at different times of day.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: So two paintings of the same pond can look quite different?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Exactly. Colour and reflection in the water meant everything to him.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Now I understand why people call him a master of light.

exercises.translation_cn: 讲解员介绍莫奈在吉维尼的著名花园;游客惊叹他多次画同一个花园;讲解员说莫奈尤其喜爱池塘里的睡莲;他反复画同一场景是为表现一天中不同时刻的光线变化;所以同一池塘的两幅画会很不同;色彩与水中倒影对他至关重要;游客明白了为何称他为光的大师。

questions.stem: Whose garden does the room show?
What was Monet especially fond of?
options: The water lilies on his pond.

questions.stem: Why did he paint the same scene again and again?
options: He was paid to do so.
To show how the light changed through the day.

questions.stem: According to the guide, what meant everything to Monet?
options: Colour and reflection in the water.

questions.stem: What does the visitor finally understand?
options: Why Monet is called a master of light.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Museum Announcement
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Welcome to the Museum of Fine Art's newest exhibition.
Our goal is to display three thousand years of Chinese art under one roof.
The highlight is a snowy mountain painting by the master Tang Yin.
You will also see bronze objects and many Buddhist sculptures.
The show runs until November, and entry is free for children under five.
exercises.translation_cn: 欢迎来到美术博物馆的最新展览;我们的目标是在一处呈现中国三千年的艺术;亮点是大师唐寅的一幅雪山图;你还能看到青铜器和许多佛教雕塑;展览持续到十一月,五岁以下儿童免费入场。

questions.stem: What is the museum's goal for this exhibition?
options: To display three thousand years of Chinese art.

questions.stem: What is the highlight of the show?
options: A snowy mountain painting by Tang Yin.

questions.stem: What else can visitors see?

Who can enter the show for free?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Advice on Learning to Paint
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: I really want to learn to paint, but I don't know how to begin.

transcript.speaker: Mr Lee
transcript.text: My advice is to start by copying a work you truly love.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Won't that stop me from finding my own style?

transcript.speaker: Mr Lee
transcript.text: Not at all. Copying first teaches your hand and eye how a master worked.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: I see. What else should I do?

transcript.speaker: Mr Lee
transcript.text: Paint a little every single day, even if it is only one small thing.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: That sounds hard, but I'll try my best.

transcript.speaker: Mr Lee
transcript.text: Don't worry about being perfect. Step by step, you will surely improve.

exercises.translation_cn: Lily 想学画却不知如何开始;李老师建议先临摹一幅你真正喜爱的作品;Lily 担心会失去自己的风格;老师说临摹能教会手和眼大师是怎么画的;Lily 又问还该做什么;老师建议每天都画一点,哪怕只是一小样东西;Lily 说有点难但会尽力;老师让她别追求完美,一步步必有进步。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 What Is Modern Art
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: After Impressionism, artists began to ask a brave new question.
They no longer wanted only to show the world as it looks.
Some broke objects into shapes; others painted dream-like or abstract scenes.
Their real aim was to make us think about what art can be.
So when a modern painting puzzles you, it is simply inviting you to wonder.
exercises.translation_cn: 印象派之后,艺术家开始提出一个大胆的新问题;他们不再只想表现世界本来的样子;有人把物体拆成形状,有人画梦幻或抽象的场景;他们真正的目标是让我们思考艺术可以是什么;所以当一幅现代画让你困惑时,它只是在邀请你去思考。

questions.stem: What did artists begin to do after Impressionism?
